SIGNATURE PRODUCT LINES

Three delivery lines.
Three distinct project needs.

NOVA, AURA, and VELARE bring focused expertise to operational spaces, premium environments, and bespoke destinations.

NOVAAURAVELARE
Fast-track & live environments

NOVA

Transforming spaces. Keeping business moving.

NOVA is our specialized construction delivery solution for fast-track refurbishment, upgrades, and improvement works in operational environments. Careful planning, phased execution, and flexible working strategies minimize disruption to ongoing operations.

From bank branches and hotels to retail outlets, malls, and administrative buildings, NOVA is structured around live environments and restricted working windows.

Services & highlights

  • Fast-track planning & execution
  • Phased works in live environments
  • Night, weekend & restricted-hour operations
  • Stakeholder & operational coordination
  • Refurbishment & upgrade works
  • Quality, safety & progress control
Premium fit-out & technical precision

AURA

Where precision meets elegance.

AURA is our premium delivery line for projects where exceptional finishes, precise detailing, and elevated material standards define the final result. Craftsmanship, technical coordination, and disciplined execution bring aesthetics, functionality, and performance together.

From premium retail and hospitality to corporate, healthcare, and educational environments, AURA manages every detail from material selection through final handover.

Services & highlights

  • Premium fit-out & finishing works
  • Material selection & technical coordination
  • Shop drawing & interface coordination
  • Mock-ups & finish evaluation
  • Specialist trade coordination
  • Value engineering & cost optimization
  • Quality control & finish inspections
Bespoke luxury & craftsmanship

VELARE

Crafted beyond the ordinary.

VELARE is our bespoke delivery line for distinctive projects where craftsmanship, individuality, and exceptional attention to detail define the experience. Refined materials and precise execution preserve the design vision and character of each space.

Created for luxury residences, private villas, fine dining, boutique hospitality, and exclusive spaces. Every project is approached individually, from bespoke detailing to specialist coordination and final finishing.

Services & highlights

  • Bespoke interior & architectural finishes
  • Luxury material selection & coordination
  • Custom joinery, metalwork & feature elements
  • Specialist finishes & artisan works
  • Bespoke detailing & mock-up development
  • Specialist contractor & supplier coordination
  • Precision quality control & final finish inspection
